The food is a single corn-on-the-cob piece, seen end-on, on a square plate of about 26 cm.

The plate spans about 350 px, so roughly 0.074 cm per px. The corn piece is about 100 px across, which is about 7 cm wide. Its length is unknown, perhaps 3-4 cm, and this looks like a cross-section of a cob with some kernels already eaten off.

A cob piece 7 cm wide and 3.5 cm long has a volume of about 135 cm³. The cob itself makes up much of that, so the edible kernels are perhaps 50-60 g. With the cob included, the total comes to roughly 100 g.

Corn runs about 90 kcal per 100 g of kernels, and the cob adds almost nothing. That gives about 70 kcal for the kernels. A few stray kernels sit on the plate, which adds little.
